data_description.control_type: Switch impulse: relay manages its own return to OFF (RF, Zigbee…). Switch sustained: HA manages activation duration. Script: RF one-shot. Cover: delegation.

data.impulse_mode: External impulse mode (relay manages its own return to OFF)
data.send_stop_at_end: Send stop at full end position (0% or 100%)
data.slat_compression_time_down: Slat compression time going down (s, 0 = disabled)
data.slat_compression_time_up: Slat decompression time going up (s, 0 = disabled)

data_description.impulse_mode: When enabled, HA only sends turn_on; the physical relay manages its own return to OFF.
data_description.switch_sustained_time: 0 = switch stays ON during movement. Ignored when external impulse mode is enabled.
data_description.send_stop_at_end: Stop at intermediate positions (1–99%) is always sent unconditionally. This option only affects full end positions.
data_description.command_delay: Delay in milliseconds applied before each physical command (open, close, stop).
data_description.slat_compression_time_down: Fixed-slat shutters: time between 'last slat on ground (ajouré)' and 'fully closed'. Determines ajoure_position attribute. 0 = disabled.
data_description.slat_compression_time_up: Time for slats to decompress when starting from 0% (opening). Usually ≥ slat_compression_time_down. 0 = disabled.
data_description.device_class: Determines the icon and states displayed in the UI.

error.travel_time_too_low: Travel time must be at least 1 second.
error.switch_required: Open and close switch entities are required.
